race.comment: THE MAGIC MAN (8) kept fresh for this and can win again from the right draw. Speared across from the wide barrier and gave nothing else a chance with a dominant on pace win over 1000m at Taree in good time. Can handle the rise in grade in this vein of form. GRASSBURN (6) senior rider hops aboard for this after she was taken back early with a disappointing eighth over 1263m at Taree. Assess on her earlier runs and can bounce back today. TAKE THE JACKPOT (10) tough old gelding with a good record at this track and trip. Shouldered the 62kg with a tiring fourth over 1204m at this track. Saves his best for this trip and the big weight drop keeps him in the mix. COOL FIZZ (9) had genuine excuses at her last two starts from wide gates with the big weights. Senior rider goes aboard today and likely to push forward from the draw.
